description: Get one account from the BAS chart of accounts by number. For its balance or postings use bokio_account_balances or bokio_account_ledger.

account.description: BAS account number, such as 1930; bokio_chart_of_accounts lists them.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

name: bokio_get_account
